UV Patch.js

Hello

It's a tool script to patch polygon object to guide polygon object with uv information.

download: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=107

caution: this script requires a lot of calculation time, so don't run for big mesh.

update: initial version had a bug. please replace it. current version is UV_Patch.js_20140410.zip.
update_20140510: calculation bug fixed. please replace it if you have.
update_20140515: warp bug fixed. please replace it if you have.
update_20140521: patch mode added.
update_20140531: normal calculation bug fixed.
update_20140606: new parameter, bug fixed. calculation speed up.

DEMO MOVIE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VnBp8siJMtc

Best

tg_jp, Hiroto.
